entities.name: Tori D'Avenant
entities.description: Human knight and cavalry officer of Dominaria, unable to use her legs, who leads the Avenant Fury Riders.

entities.name: D'Avenant family
entities.description: Noble family with a rare degenerative condition.

events.summary: Tori refused to be held back and became a cavalry officer despite losing the use of her legs.
events.quote: Tori refused to be held back.

relations.quote: she leads the Avenant Fury Riders into battle
Tori was born into the noble D'Avenant family
